summary: Plan RCT protocols, allocation and M&E data collection, then interpret findings. Explore this practical five-day training outline.
lede: Randomized control trials in monitoring and evaluation help teams plan feasible evaluations and interpret intervention outcomes. For evaluation officers, programme managers and research staff, the course covers framing causal questions, choosing allocation methods, planning outcome measures and data collection, and interpreting intention-to-treat findings and trial reporting concepts.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who commission, design or use randomized evaluations and need to connect trial design decisions with practical monitoring, data collection and programme reporting.
prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with programme objectives, indicators or routine monitoring and evaluation data. Coding is not required; exercises use evaluation scenarios and spreadsheet-based calculations.
